system.description:
ARCHIVIST

Your Prayer Book has ceased to resemble an organised volume and begun to resemble an argument conducted across several generations.
You gain a +2-class bonus to Linguistics checks made to Learn a Spell from a written Divinity source.
Whenever you successfully copy a Divinity spell into your Prayer Book, the time and mundane material cost required are halved.
In addition, immediately add four Divinity spells that you are capable of casting to your Prayer Book.

Works automatically: +2 class is offered on Linguistics with the book's wording; the four extra Prayer Book spells and the halved copying cost are for the table (add them to the book from its own sheet).

conditionals.label: Sacred Marginalia
conditionals.scope: Linguistics checks to Learn a Spell from a written Divinity source
